reason: Retain the 33-file database lifecycle as one authority. Atomic exchange removes the empty-occupant workaround; platform syscalls belong to fseffect while journal identities, retained-copy equivalence, store-space bounds, and restart decisions remain with db. Committed-WAL preservation, process interruption, older-build writes before exchange, and deterministic allocation failure contracts support this boundary. The full production-copy migration also preserved all 159 retained roots. Empty-file exchange preflight stays beside beginRebuild, retaining the same lifecycle. Focused tests cover unsupported flags, cleanup, installed restart retirement, and refusal to seal an open WAL connection.
